items.title: Mother of Iranian footballer pleads for her to stay in Australia, saying 'they'll kill you'
items.description: The smiles and joy seen in pictures of the seven members of the Iranian women's football team who sought asylum in Australia only tell part of the story, with many still scared for their families back home.

items.title: Live: Iran vows retaliation for US-Israeli strikes on residential areas
items.description: A spokesman for the Iranian armed forces also accused the US and Israel of using civilians as human shields, an accusation often levelled by Israel at its enemies in the Middle East. Follow live.

items.title: Dubai's 'tranquillity shattered' as Iran makes UAE a primary target
items.description: The United Arab Emirates is reporting more Iranian attacks than any other country as Tehran continues to retaliate against US and Israeli strikes.

items.title: Hundreds of millions wagered on Iran through online betting markets
items.description: Gambling experts and US lawmakers have raised concerns about the ethics of online betting and whether insider information is helping profiteers cash in on war.

items.title: IDF build-up on Israel-Lebanon border
items.description: An IDF military build-up on the Israel-Lebanon border is forcing hundreds of thousands of Lebanese people to seek refuge. Up and down the border there is the presence of Israeli tanks, soldiers and reservists. The UN says people displaced due to this military operation have limited options and it's causing a massive humanitarian crisis.  Let's take a closer look at what's unfolded.

items.title: Breaking: Magnitude 4.4 earthquake shakes regional NSW
items.description: Thousands of people report feeling a magnitude 4.4 earthquake that has hit Boorowa in southern New South Wales.

items.title: War, oil, inflation are all creating interest rate perfect storm
items.description: Expectations the Reserve Bank will hike the cash rate next week are rising as leading economists shift their forecasts — and some say one increase may not be enough.

items.title: He wasn't a typical National. Now he's leading the party
items.description: Matt Canavan once claimed to be an atypical Nationals member. Now the pro-mining Queenslander is leading the party from the Senate.

items.title: Two people arrested less than a week after hate speech laws pass parliament
items.description: Police say a man has been charged and a woman is assisting them with inquiries over the use of phrases deemed antisemitic by the Queensland government.

items.title: What happens when online NAPLAN testing is disrupted?
items.description: Technical difficulties delayed NAPLAN testing across the country today. Here's how to navigate disruptions and what it means for your child.

items.title: More pain to come after Qantas hikes international airfares
items.description: As Qantas hikes international airfares due to a surge in fuel prices from the Middle East war, an industry expert warns it's only the start of what's to come.

items.title: More views of SA Liberal candidate emerge against Islam and 'trans agenda'
items.description: More views by Liberal Party candidate and evangelical Christian Carston Woodhouse emerge with the Adelaide man saying Islam is "poisonous and wrong" and the "trans agenda is insanity". Warning: This story contains content some readers might find distressing.

items.title: Government doubles graduate visa fee but some countries exempt
items.description: Tiered pricing for visas is being used to support Pacific nations but some fear it could be misused to target certain communities.

items.title: WOMADelaide 2026 was pure joy — here’s what went down
items.description: At Adelaide's global music weekender, tens of thousands transform everyday anxieties into a shared burst of joy.

items.title: Chance find reunites former cop with the protester he arrested
items.description: Ian Wright captured the Franklin River blockade on film. Forty years later, the officer who arrested him reached out.

items.title: Man arrested, teen on the run after alleged four-day crime spree
items.description: A Mildura man has been remanded in custody and his accomplice remains on the run after the pair allegedly went on a four-day crime spree across Victoria.

items.title: Main link between Sydney and western NSW to be closed for weeks
items.description: A crucial bridge on the Great Western Highway linking Sydney to the state's Central West will be shut for at least a fortnight, while specialists assess why it is moving and cracking.

items.title: Quiz: Can you find your way around the world?
items.description: Where would you find the Frank Lloyd Wright marvel, Fallingwater? And what's the capital of Fiji?

items.title: Commercial rat baits to be banned from supermarket shelves
items.description: Rat baits could soon be restricted to licensed operators after a change in regulations from the Australian Pesticides and Veterinary Medicines Authority.

items.title: NT government knocks back move to scrutinise bullying claims against MLA
items.description: The NT government has knocked back an attempt to launch a parliamentary inquiry into bullying claims against backbencher Tanzil Rahman, while Speaker Robyn Lambley has slammed Dr Rahman for his response to the allegations.

items.title: Triple killer lived with two foster children, minister lashes department
items.description: NSW Minister for Families and Communities Kate Washington says the mistake is the worst she has seen in her time in the portfolio.

items.title: Katie Perry wins High Court trademark case against Katy Perry
items.description: Australian fashion designer Katie Perry wins her High Court battle against international pop star Katy Perry in a long-running trademark case.

items.title: Bus company linked to fatal wedding crash admits to heavy vehicle breaches
items.description: The bus company linked to the deadly 2023 Hunter Valley wedding bus crash and a director plead guilty to heavy-vehicle law safety breaches.

items.title: Former inspector tells CFMEU inquiry she felt pressured to issue $3,600 fine
items.description: A Workplace Health and Safety Queensland told the inquiry she believed the regulator had formed an "alliance" with the CFMEU.

items.title: Daylesford crash inquest hears doctor has concerns for driver's memory
items.description: The diabetes doctor of the driver responsible for a 2023 collision in the Victorian town of Daylesford, that killed five people, tells a coronial inquest that he is "concerned" for his patient's memory.
